description_en: Sets, modifies, or deletes the inter-region bandwidth between two regions in a bandwidth package of a Basic Edition transit router
description_zh: 调用SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit接口设置、修改或删除基础版转发路由器带宽包中两个地域间的跨地域互通带宽
kebab_example: aliyun cbn set-cen-inter-region-bandwidth-limit --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmx0000 --local-region-id cn-hangzhou --opposite-region-id us-west-1 --bandwidth-limit 8 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the local region.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html to query the regions of the network instances that can be attached to a CEN instance
parameters.help_zh:
本端地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取云企业网支持加载的网络实例的地域信息
parameters.name: local_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the peer region
parameters.name: opposite_region_id

parameters.help_en: The inter-region bandwidth between the two regions. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 两个地域之间的跨地域互通带宽。单位：Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth_limit

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth allocation method. Valid values:

BandwidthPackage (default): Bandwidth is allocated from the bandwidth package
parameters.help_zh:
带宽的分配方式。取值：

BandwidthPackage（默认值）：从带宽包中分配带宽
parameters.name: bandwidth_type
